description: This file defines React components for displaying an agent legend in a workflow DAG UI, specifically the 'AgentLegend' component and its mini version, for selecting and filtering agents associated with workflow nodes.

methods.name: AgentLegend
methods.description: React functional component that displays a list of agents with filtering capabilities, either in a compact or full mode, based on the number of agents and user interaction.

methods.name: AgentLegendMini
methods.description: Simplified version of the agent legend for small spaces, displaying agent color dots with optional filter interaction.
